content:
TEMPTATION ||| Lean closer, letting my breath ghost over his ear ||| "What if I just told them the truth?"  
BOUNDARY ||| Step back, releasing his grip, breaking the tension ||| "This isn’t the time for games, Julian."  
CONFESSION ||| Meet his gaze, my heart racing with honesty ||| "I can't shake the feeling that you know more."  
REVERSAL ||| Take a step forward, reclaiming the blade ||| "I will answer, but on my terms."  
SILENCE ||| Close my eyes, feeling the weight of their stares ||| *A shaky breath.*
